triage.source: PROVISIONAL classification-only demo. Every case requires clinician review; model predictions do not set an abnormal or normal screen status. The model calls two of three benign golden images malignant. No threshold was validated on held-out patients; sensitivity and specificity for the app's preprocessing are UNVERIFIED (pack README).

provenance.source: DenseNet-121 checkpoint saved/models/BCDensenet/0224_034642/model_best.pth from https://github.com/mrdvince/breast_cancer_detection, recorded upstream revision 8c5028c. provenance.licence: Upstream repository declares MIT; NOTICE_MIT_mrdvince.txt is included. Dataset-derived model redistribution is UNVERIFIED; resolve against UFPR BreakHis terms before distributing weights.
training_data: BreakHis breast tumour H&E histology; upstream training split and held-out patient performance are UNVERIFIED by DeepSight.
provenance.notes: Provisional demo pack. Quality rejection is DISABLED (min_blur=0, max_clipped_fraction=1), pending calibration; a quality pass is not proof of suitability. No uncertainty estimator is calibrated (method none). Max score aggregation and min_fields=1 are engineering conventions, not clinical thresholds. Normalization is inside the graph: supply RGB/255 only. Labels are benign, malignant; the model outputs logits and the engine applies softmax once. Android uses floating-point bilinear stretch; historical Pillow-resize metrics do not establish performance for this preprocessing. No held-out accuracy or latency claim is made.
